data.gender_notes: Wileen is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Vilis', meaning 'shining' or 'protector'. In Christian tradition, associated with the virtues of faith and light. The name Wileen carries the meaning “Protector, Shining Light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Wileen usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, shining light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing the inner light of faith and the protective nature of the divine.
data.etymology: Wileen belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Shining Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Wileen total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
